capture_metadata.source: Actual first decode projection tensors, captured from passing optimized decoder

source.preceding_computation: HF FP32 eager, FP32 checkpoint weights and KV, original scaled embedding and layer scalars
source.sampling: Actual corpus token continuation; no generated or random activations

declared_peak_scope: Explicit aggregate SKU assumption; weight-only bandwidth excludes activation/output traffic
timing_scope: One warmed linear per trace; host wall includes dispatch/synchronization. Native CSV required for device time.
integration_status: No runtime policy changes; a winning isolated candidate still requires whole-layer integration

geometry.estimates_scope: Weight payload/header bytes only; not total CB/L1 allocation. Screening flags are heuristics.
